method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager, headquartered in New York. Strategy roles are in-house (corporate strategy, business strategy, chief-of-staff teams); entry is mainly through its two-year Full-Time Analyst Program.
business_type: In-house strategy at an asset manager

early_career.text: Two-year Full-Time Analyst Program: orientation and training, then placement on a team with ongoing training.
early_career.significance: Structured entry, though most analyst roles are investment or operations rather than strategy.

employee_support.text: Analyst postings list birth-parent, non-birth-parent and adoption leave and fertility benefits; summaries mention a return-to-work program after parental leave.
employee_support.significance: Return-to-work support addresses the transition back, not only the leave.

flexibility.text: A BlackRock careers page describes a hybrid model of at least four office days a week, with some groups requiring more.
